snippets.snippet: PERU TOWNSHIP COMPREHENSIVE PLAN PAGE 5 RECOMMENDATIONS The following action plan contains specific, achievable, measurable steps that will be taken to achieve the agreed - upon goals and objectives. 1. In order to promote rural character and retain agricultural open space, it is suggested that limited zoning regulations be considered and presented to the voters of Peru Township for consideration. Such should adequately provide for development while promoting conservation through a mix of land use regulations that encourage low density, conservation practices, agricultural farmland preservation, permanent open spaces and preservation of quality of life indicators while providing the upmost property owner rights. 2.
